description: The AZHARI COLLECTION S-9 Smart Digital Tasbih Counter Ring is the perfect fusion of spirituality and modern technology. Designed for Muslims who wish to keep track of their dhikr (zikr) and tasbih during prayer, this compact smart ring features a clear OLED display, allowing you to monitor your counts at a glance. With touch-enabled control, a simple tap lets you count effortlessly, while vibration alerts at milestone counts (33, 66, 99, or 100) help maintain focus during prayer without constantly checking the screen. Crafted with an adjustable finger size design, it fits comfortably on most fingers and is suitable for both men and women. Powered by a USB rechargeable battery. The ring is made from durable and lightweight materials, and its water-resistant build makes it ideal for daily use—even during wudu..
